item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "b8f6758ab492397c1b3896e0a79d762cb7abd848cf00c08b7b79a3df8632b05d",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A family of system types indexed by real constants K and rho. The supplied constructor packages rho ≠ 0, two real-valued functions p and u on R × R, and the pointwise derivative conditions of D008.",
      "effect_on_target": "The theorem quantifies over a supplied system, thereby taking its pressure and velocity as data. Interpreting all constructor requirements as necessary properties of every system depends on the constructor description being exhaustive.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The second projection of a system, a function p : R → R → R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies pressure p in the expression p(x,t) + rho c u(x,t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The third projection of a system, a function u : R → R → R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies velocity u in the expression p(x,t) + rho c u(x,t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for the pointwise transport predicate D006, specialized to a real-valued function.",
      "effect_on_target": "The second conclusion asserts existence of the two partial derivatives of the specified function and the equation w_t + c w_x = 0 at every point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Given p, u, rho and c, defines w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (rho c)u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the transported quantity explicitly; it is not an existentially chosen function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For a function q : R → R → E into a real normed vector space, the predicate at speed c and point (x,t) is: there exist qt,qx in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + c • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "At E = R, the conclusion is ∀ x,t ∈ R, ∃ wt,wx ∈ R, with both slice derivative assertions and wt + c wx = 0. Witnesses may depend on the system, parameters and point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Constructs a system at K,rho from rho ≠ 0, functions p,u : R → R → R, and a proof that D008 holds for every real x,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exhibits the intended bundled assumptions on the input system. No system is constructed or existentially asserted by the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "At (x,t), there exist real pt,px,ut,ux witnessing the time and space slice derivatives of p and u respectively, with pt + K ux = 0 and ut + rho⁻¹ px = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The supplied system constructor requires these first-order equations at every real point. The four derivative witnesses are chosen pointwise, after x and t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication R × E → E is continuous for every real normed vector space E.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides derivative infrastructure for D006; it imposes no additional regularity assumption on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on R is continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides derivative infrastructure for the real-valued functions in D008, without assuming continuity of their derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both c > 0 and the everywhere transport assertion are required; all derivative and equation clauses within each predicate also hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a multiplicative structure with inverse and division.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects real division in K/rho.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the binary division operation from an HDiv instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed quotient as K divided by rho.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity of K/rho and its square root using the real order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal in its specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The literal 0 is real zero in the positivity assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Parameters, coordinates, function values and specialized derivative witnesses are real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inversion and division, with division equal to multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "K/rho uses ordinary real field division, totalized at zero in Lean.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "The hypothesis excludes zero and negative ratios; the first conclusion is strict positivity of c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the threshold in positivity comparisons and the zero in real equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Maps a real number to its nonnegative part, takes the nonnegative square root, and returns it as a real number; it is zero for nonpositive inputs.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes c = sqrt(K/rho) as the nonnegative square root, which is strictly positive under the ratio hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Uses the zero element of a type to interpret the numeral 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the numeral in real inequalities denotes the real additive identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary division as its homogeneous HDiv operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the target's division notation to real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the binary addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the sum defining w and the sums in the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the binary multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms rho c u, K ux and rho⁻¹ px using real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes D006 to real-valued functions and makes c • wx equal c wx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "All specialized sums are ordinary sums of real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "All coefficient products in w and the system equations are ordinary real products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group of real numbers with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the normed codomain structure used to interpret real derivatives and the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm, compatible metric and multiplicative norm law.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar calculus and the canonical normed vector space structure on R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Promotes ordinary addition to homogeneous HAdd.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition notation in the function definition and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes ordinary multiplication to homogeneous HMul.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves multiplication notation to the supplied real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, subtraction and negation of an additive commutative group as a SubtractionCommMonoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive infrastructure for the derivative predicates; it changes no equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the addition used on the codomain of D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in obtaining codomain addition without adding a hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains commutative addition from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the addition used in qt + c • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and its two-sided zero identity from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive zero structure for the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure carrying addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero on the right side of the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition-and-zero data from an additive zero class.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the codomain zero in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field has a nontrivial norm, with its normed field structure retained.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication preserving zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar action used in the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains a scalar action and its preservation of zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in resolving c • qx; it imposes no new assumption on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets definiteness of an extended norm on an additive commutative monoid while retaining its operations and extended seminorm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited codomain structure used in D006, without changing the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero for the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the extended-seminormed additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the codomain additive operations used in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides codomain addition and zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The differential equations are exact equalities to zero, not estimates or approximate identities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual derivative witnesses at each point: four in D008 and two in D006. These quantifiers are inside the point quantifiers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms c • qx in D006, which specializes to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter at that point and a fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary derivatives of the one-variable slices on all of R, not merely formal derivative symbols or weak derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar multiplication for derivatives and the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system constructor requires rho ≠ 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the inherited additive identity in the calculus infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is part of the general codomain requirements of D006; the target instantiates it with R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive group required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an additive commutative monoid with a definite extended norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the normed codomain to inherited addition and zero structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group and induced pseudometric while weakening a normed group to a seminormed group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure needed to form the real normed space and its topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with scalar multiplication compatible with the norms.",
      "effect_on_target": "D006 uses a real normed vector space in general; the target uses the canonical real normed space R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar action required for HasDerivAt and c • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the norm-induced pseudometric to the topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has norms between any two positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides, through D039, the nontrivial norm required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The multiplicative monoid structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real products, division infrastructure and scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure inherited from the real field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the canonical module and scalar action; it adds no restriction on real parameters.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar multiplication in the transport relation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology underlying the derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation and the law that negation fixes zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inherited route to codomain zero, without changing the equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining a subtraction monoid's operations and laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited additive infrastructure for the calculus predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains subtraction and negation data and derives that negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the additive identity used in derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides neighborhoods for derivative assertions in the codomain topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes an ordinary scalar action to HSMul.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the scalar multiplication notation in qt + c • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and zero from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive monoid needed for the module and scalar action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity of an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves additive operations used by the derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, subtraction and negation data from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited additive operations and zero; it adds no condition on the functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the scalar multiplication map (a,v) ↦ a • v.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural requirement for the derivative predicate, supplied by D009 or D010; it is not a hypothesis that p or u is jointly continuous.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real algebraic structure used for modules and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative division and semiring structure of a field while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real multiplication, inversion and division used in the target and system equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the unary inverse operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes rho⁻¹ in ut + rho⁻¹ px = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real multiplication in scalar action and division infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining a nonunital seminormed ring's operations and topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a route to the additive norm and topology required for real calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed additive commutative group underlying a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive codomain topology used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real normed field operations in the calculus infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains ring operations, norm and pseudometric while weakening a normed commutative ring to a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real field operations used for coefficients and the self-module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The ordinary additive commutative group of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition, subtraction and zero for real-valued derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "Real multiplicative inversion, with inverse zero equal to zero in the field convention.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the reciprocal coefficient rho⁻¹ and contributes to K/rho; the positive-ratio hypothesis excludes rho = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring with its usual norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the standard norm and topology through inherited structures, with no alternative notion of differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric given by d(x,y) = |x-y| and its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative assertions use ordinary real neighborhoods.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains division semiring structure from a semifield.",
